body:
## What's Changed
* Share docking transactions and preserve FilmCraft panel behavior by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/881
* ci: refactor workflows to use storytold/craft-common-actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1051
* #853: Shift constrains pen mask segments to 45° steps by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/862
* Reveal in Finder for Project clips with a local path by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/889
* fix(media): RF64 trailing metadata stays outside audio duration by @mjohnson7cd in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/944
* Keep nested sequence markers in OTIO export by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/947
* Export: correct loudness lost to peak limiting by @earlvanze in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/952
* Keep New Sequence open when frame size is rejected by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/974
* #980: VP9 decode loop-filters a frame as a superblock-row wavefront by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/995
* #790: Matroska AAC / MP3 / AC-3 trims the exact CodecDelay by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/792
* #923: reordered Matroska video without DefaultDuration keeps its frame rate by @JordyUSA in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/986
* timeline: box selection updates live while dragging by @ReReddo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1028
* Engine: list edge, params and reverse in the sequence.applyAudioTransition schema (#1100) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1107
* Timeline: keep continuous thumbnails fixed while the view zooms (#1094) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1108
* fix(effects): keep a setParam keyframe outside the clip at its time (#1055) by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1120
* dock: the mouse wheel over a tab strip switches tabs by @ReReddo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1032
* Roll linked audio with the picture cut by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/870
* #243: text fields keep unmodified keys so IMEs can compose by @opentechnepal in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/888
* One undo for a Scale (and similar) mouse drag by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/892
* Essential Graphics: an Install refused shows why on the status bar (#611) by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/949
* fix(render): update Noise grain on every frame using exact timestamps by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/956
* Timeline: a drag with Track Select Forward/Backward moves what it selects by @mktk1117 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/979
* fix: 値グラフからキーフレームの補間を選択 #962 by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1138
* tools: press and drag a grouped tool to open its flyout by @ReReddo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1030
* meters: adapt to the panel's size; react while scrubbing by @ReReddo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1031
* fix(render): 5.1 sources on a stereo track fold down instead of losing C and surrounds by @ossini in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1036
* Timeline: a press on the ruler moves the playhead at once (#1090) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1109
* fix(cli): fail export/render that drew offline media unless --allow-offline (#1054) by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1121
* fix: パネルのフォーカス枠の欠けを修正 #1075 by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1144
* macOS: app menu follows the interface language (#1145) by @keller-lukas in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1151
* Keep recovery snapshots when session metadata is unreadable by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/932
* monitors: about 10% of zoom per wheel notch, exactly reversible by @ReReddo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1026
* Underline vertical graphic text by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1044
* Underline follows baseline shift on whole-style text by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1045
* Fix #1072: Text panel 'Import captions file…' button label invisible in light mode by @mjohnson7cd in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1084
* #1091: Home / End and other jumps scroll the Timeline to the playhead by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1097
* fix: 再生停止後も音量メーターを更新 #1062 by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1133
* Hot-text number fields select the whole value when clicked (#1126) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1166
* #867: Indonesian (id) interface translation by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/878
* #847: AV1 decode runs deblocking, CDEF and loop restoration in parallel row bands by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/886

* Match Frame on a reversed clip uses moving source time by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/973

* WIN: stabilize Windows verification prerequisites by @jahvari in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/989
* Reject non-finite numbers and empty LUT input ranges in .cube import (#998) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1012
* #1018: Scene Edit Detection in the timeline clip's right-click menu by @ossini in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1048
* fix: サブクリップ配置で親の音声を保持 #913 by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1099
* Escape cancels a drag in progress: drag-and-drop, value drags, color pickers and dialogs by @ReReddo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/608

* fix(tts-text): preserve magnitude, fractions and leading zeros in narration by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/954
* Move fade-out with a non-ripple Speed/Duration change by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/969

* Clamp Automate Cross Dissolve to the placed overlap by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/976

name: FilmCraft v0.6.0
body:
## What's Changed
* CLI: a closed stderr no longer panics with exit 101 (#537) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/567
* CLI export: forward a lone --start or --end so the engine reports the missing bound (#538) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/568
* Roll: reversed clips take the cut from the opposite source end (#526) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/558
* fix(edit): reversed trims use the media handle their playback direction consumes (#527) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/559
* Trim: extend each selected edit point to the playhead by its own distance (#528) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/560
* Linked slip: clamp to one shared delta so picture and sound stay aligned (#529) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/561
* Frame-held Regular In trim stops at the previous clip instead of overlapping it (#530) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/562
* Export settings: accept camelCase for nested snake_case fields (#531) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/563
* Queue move: saturate a huge relative offset instead of overflowing (#532) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/564
* Forced relink and Replace Footage keep the new file's properties (#534) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/565
* Project Manager: keep every parent of a nested subclip when collecting (#535) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/566
* Parametric Equalizer: use the full EQ so master gain, bands 1/2/4/5 and pass filters reach the audio (#540) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/570
* Audio Gain: measure the peak of the audio stream each clip plays (#541) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/571
* masks.addVertex: clamp oversized index on animated paths, reject empty paths instead of panicking (#543) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/572
* MCC export: end each ancillary packet with its checksum byte so FFmpeg reads the captions (#544) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/573
* Text panel: word navigation ignores a selection the transcript no longer has (#546) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/574
* Slide: keep reversed neighbours' source ranges correct (#548) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/575
* #323: AAF files open in readers that load the meta-dictionary by @txiki739 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/419
* Keep selected audio streams distinct in AAF/OMF exports by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/467
* interchange: fix file:// URLs for Windows verbatim paths (FCP7 XML media offline in Premiere) by @digitaldecaycreations-lgtm in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/497
* Export sequence markers to a spreadsheet-safe CSV by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/454
* #447: HybridDecoder fallback replay goes on past samples the software decoder rejects by @MrCloudy2 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/453
* fix(export): Selection as Project exports a selected bin's contents (#536) by @maxm11 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/557
* Issue #545: captions.list with a track that names no caption track is an error by @LloydNicholson in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/556
* MCP render_frame: max_side 0 means no limit (#459) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/464
* Keep frame navigation precise and time arithmetic bounded by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/494
* #219: right-clicking a cut opens the edit point menu by @MrCloudy2 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/257
* Audio plays while scrubbing (#211) by @carlitosteso3 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/275
* Audio of video clips: volume in Effect Controls + draggable volume line (#223) by @ossini in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/472
* Preview transition placement while dragging onto timeline clips (#482) by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/487
* timeline, monitors: drag the current-time timecode to scrub, click to type a time by @ReReddo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/576
* #484: Enable flips each selected clip on its own by @liangforstudy in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/511
* Fill graphic shapes and text with a linear gradient by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/514
* ui: add an eyedropper to colour parameters (Ultra Key, Color Key...) by @Guilhermeb-Ferrarezi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/518
* graphics: shape commands document `seconds` / `track` / `time`, and placement errors name the command that asked by @maccagnit in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/521
* Project files: each sequence reopens with its playhead where it was left by @liangforstudy in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/506
* Implement scrollable areas for media dialog by @chuygarcia92 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/516
* i18n: the tl! source scan in tests passes on CRLF checkouts by @ReReddo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/488
* Text panel: tab widths follow the drawn label (Japanese tabs overlapped) by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/450
* i18n: Japanese for the whole interface by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/449
* Fix Light theme inconsistencies by @adurr21 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/555
* #474: VA-API decoders share one display (no 0.3 s open / 70 ms close per decoder on NVIDIA) by @MrCloudy2 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/475
* M-HW: NVENC takes the export's RGBA and converts it on the GPU (#30) by @MasakatsuFunaki in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/486
* Issue #552: MP4 and Matroska colour from the bitstream when the container has none by @LloydNicholson in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/446
* #346: the from-source Flatpak includes the CLI and MCP server by @txiki739 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/420

body:
## What's Changed
* fix: filmcraft-cli exits quietly on broken pipe (#285) by @mjohnson7cd in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/297
* #341: CLI export message names the file written, not the requested path by @JordyUSA in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/362
* chore(lints): satisfy strict workspace Clippy on Rust 1.95 by @WavJaby in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/252
* #379: preset export and import go through the host, so the web build no longer traps by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/393
* #340: FCP7 XML clip source span always matches its record span by @txiki739 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/392
* #318: a reversed clip shows exactly its source range by @txiki739 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/394
* fix: frame stepping broken for non-standard frame rates (#301) by @mjohnson7cd in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/324
* #382: File > Export entries work from the menus by @txiki739 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/391
* #259: the edge you press is the edge you trim by @ItzBloxy in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/399
* macOS DMG: branded window background and icon layout by @XusBadia in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/263
* HW5: Linux VA-API hardware decoding for H.264 and HEVC (Main / Main 10) by @JordyUSA in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/358
* #214: install script for the Linux tarball by @txiki739 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/387
* Desktop: write log records to standard error and a rotating log file by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/249
* M10: keep combining marks in one vertical text cell by @midasdf in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/289
* M10: use Japanese vertical forms and origins for titles by @midasdf in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/277
* Issue #139: portable.txt next to the exe keeps the data directory beside it by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/303
* Go to In / Go to Out move to the sequence start / end without marks (#208) by @carlitosteso3 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/221
* Program monitor: the picture follows a value that is dragged by @justjohn12345 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/304
* Keyframes: Properties gets Premiere's navigator, Effect Controls a time ruler by @justjohn12345 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/307
* #220: Unlink leaves only the right-clicked clip selected by @MrCloudy2 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/250
* shortcuts: Delete clears the selected timeline clips (#243) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/261
* engine: project.delete takes explicit bin ids without a Project-panel selection (#244) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/253
* fix(import): use the open Project bin as destination by @WavJaby in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/241
* Decode caches: navigation bursts no longer keep every clip's decoder and frames (#55) by @SaymonMaster14 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/381
* Thumbnails decode with small decoders that are not kept (#55) by @SaymonMaster14 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/385
* fix(gpu): normalize YUV code ranges independently of texture scaling by @WavJaby in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/319
* Embedding: set_context on the web app, header and status bar flags, status bar colour token by @rossaai in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/349
* Windows: export paths expand ~, accept trailing \ and verbatim paths by @Tom1tk in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/282
* #296: Auto-Match measures a mono clip as one channel by @Pathos0925 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/305
* mixer: report only the audio gains actually applied by @storybored379 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/373
* graphics: keep duration separate from timeline placement by @storybored379 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/372
* MCP: cancelling a movie export keeps numbered files beside it by @storybored379 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/369
* export: keep alpha in PNG/TIFF sequences (Include Alpha Channel) (#160) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/242
